item.title: Shock defeat to Bangladesh reveals bigger picture hiding in plain sight
item.description: On paper, Australia's full-strength team should have wiped the floor with Bangladesh. But a lack of application to their Test match craft has left Australia vulnerable to teams that are driven to succeed in the longest format. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Bangladesh thrash Australia in one of Test cricket's greatest upsets
item.description: Bangladesh thrash Australia by nine wickets on the fourth day of the series-opener in Darwin to complete one of Test cricket's greatest upsets. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Japan’s defence minister heads to Australia to meet Marles in wake of melon-gate controversy
item.description: Discussions to focus on Australia’s acquisition of Mogami-class frigates as Japan plays down Albanese’s podcast comments Japan’s defence minister will visit Canberra this week, the highest level engagement with Australia after controversy over Anthony Albanese’s comments about a gift of melons from prime minister Sanae Takaichi. The defence minister, Shinjiro Koizumi, will meet his counterpart and deputy prime minister, Richard Marles, on Tuesday, with discussions focused on Australia’s acquisition of Japan’s Mogami-class frigates and enhanced security cooperation. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Australia gun buyback spurred by Bondi attack to start in November, PM says
item.description: Australia introduced measures to reduce gun ownership following a deadly attack on Sydney's Bondi Beach last year. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: She designed jumpers worn by Princess Diana and Olivia Newton-John, then lost everything

item.title: Violent threats surge in WA schools, forcing more lock downs, report shows
item.description: Public schools were forced into lockdown 1,300 times last year, according to figures tabled in Parliament this week, and most of those were triggered by violent threats made against students or staff. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says many of the deaths occurring in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are happening outside of known transmission chains, meaning the outbreak is a long way from being brought under control. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Victoria Police to recruit retired officers amid staffing shortfall
item.description: Hundreds of police reservists will be recruited in a bid to lighten the administrative load for frontline officers and address a nearly 1,500 member deficit in staff numbers. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australia urged to lead Indo-Pacific cable shield as hybrid war risks rise
item.description: The cables that link Australia with the rest of the world lie mostly unseen, stretched across the seabed and threaded through some of the Indo-Pacific’s busiest and most contested waters. This vulnerability could also become a strategic advantage, a new report says, urging Australia to position itself as an “Indo-Pacific preferred cable hub” as threats to submarine cables raise economic and national security risks across the region. That view is echoed by regional analysts, who say Canberra... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
